pages.text: Somewhere inside the bee nests is a whole other world. Throw an ender pearl at a nest to find it.

Don't anger the bees. $(l:bees/bumblezone#honey_compass)Honey Compasses$(/l) lead to its structures, and the rarest ones lead to the $(l)Bee Queen$(), who trades if you bring what she wants.$(br2)Fall through the bottom to get home.
